description: Step 1 of paying on your own, with no person at a checkout page: call it after hip_quote and before hip_complete_payment. Resolve the EXACT amount HIP will charge, before any payment authorization is obtained or spent. This does NOT charge anything. Returns subtotal_cents, tax_cents, total_cents, currency, a pricing fingerprint and the authorization types HIP accepts. Tax is calculated by Stripe from the destination, so hip_quote alone is not the payable amount. The returned total is bound to this job's documents, options and recipient: change any of them and payment is refused with QUOTE_STALE until you prepare again. Use this when paying autonomously with a delegated payment authorization; a human paying in a browser does not need it. Commits the job to the autonomous payment rail.

address_confirmed.description: optional, no longer needed: accepted for compatibility and ignored.

buyer_email.description: optional: the buyer's email address. Have It Printed sends its order confirmation there once the payment succeeds.

job_handle.description: the job_handle that hip_create_job returned (job_ followed by 32 hex characters). Only the API key that created the job can use it.

name: hip_prepare_payment
title: Prepare the exact payable total
